title: examples/app-crm: polish dashboard metadata to match objectui reference
body:
The CRM example dashboards looked dated compared to the [objectui CRM reference](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/tree/main/examples/crm/src/dashboards) — they leaned on raw hex strings stuffed into `options.color` and ignored most of the `Dashboard`/`DashboardWidget` schema (no `colorVariant`, `chartConfig`, `header`, `dateRange`, `globalFilters`, descriptions, drill-down actions, or trend indicators).

### Changes

- **New `crm.dashboard.ts`** — unified CRM Overview that mirrors the objectui reference (KPI tiles → area revenue trend + donut → funnel + bar → recent-deals table).
- **Rewrote `executive` / `sales` / `service` dashboards** to use first-class metadata fields:
  - Semantic `colorVariant` (`success`/`warning`/`danger`/`blue`/`teal`/`purple`/`orange`) replaces hex `options.color`.
  - `chartConfig` per chart: axis titles, value formats (`$0,0`, `0%`), color palette, annotations (e.g. quota line on sales trend), brush/zoom interaction.
  - Richer chart mix: `area` for trends, `donut` for distribution, `funnel` for pipeline, `gauge` for SLA compliance, `horizontal-bar` for rep ranking.
  - KPI metric widgets carry `icon`, `format`, and a `trend: { value, direction, label }` payload in `options`.
  - Tables use structured `columns: [{ header, accessorKey, format }]` instead of bare field-name arrays.
- **Dashboard chrome**: every dashboard declares `header.actions` (New / Reports / Export), `dateRange`, `globalFilters` (owner / industry / priority lookups), `refreshInterval`, per-widget `description`, and `actionUrl`/`actionType`/`actionIcon` for drill-down.
- **`test/dashboard.test.ts`** — 20 tests parsing each dashboard against `DashboardSchema` and enforcing the new conventions (no raw hex in `options.color`, every widget has a description, header has at least one action, dateRange present).
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — entry under `[Unreleased] → Changed`.

### Example: KPI tile, before vs after

```ts
// Before — hex stuffed into a free-form options blob, no drill-down, no trend
{
  id: 'closed_won_this_quarter',
  title: 'Closed Won This Quarter',
  type: 'metric',
  object: 'opportunity',
  filter: { stage: 'closed_won', close_date: { $gte: '{current_quarter_start}' } },
  valueField: 'amount',
  aggregate: 'sum',
  layout: { x: 3, y: 0, w: 3, h: 2 },
  options: { prefix: '$', color: '#00AA00' }
}

// After — semantic colorVariant, drill-down, icon + format + trend indicator
{
  id: 'closed_won_qtd',
  title: 'Closed Won (QTD)',
  description: 'Revenue closed this quarter',
  type: 'metric',
  object: 'opportunity',
  filter: { stage: 'closed_won', close_date: { $gte: '{current_quarter_start}' } },
  valueField: 'amount',
  aggregate: 'sum',
  colorVariant: 'success',
  actionUrl: '/reports/closed-won',
  actionType: 'url',
  actionIcon: 'ArrowUpRight',
  layout: { x: 3, y: 0, w: 3, h: 2 },
  options: {
    icon: 'Trophy',
    format: '$0,0',
    prefix: '$',
    trend: { value: 14.7, direction: 'up', label: 'vs last quarter' },
  },
}
```

No schema or runtime changes — the framework already supported all of these fields; the example just wasn't using them.
